name: Neural Depth Renderer as DDF
aliases: Neural Depth Rendering as Directed Distance Field
definition: A neural depth renderer f mapping camera parameters Π and shapes ΛS to depth/visibility images is treated as a conditional DDF. Each pixel value is (d(p, v), ξ(p, v)), where p is the camera center of projection and v is the ray direction determined by camera intrinsics/extrinsics.
